Addresses all four blockers in https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2709#issuecomment-6226265779:
- LF-split diff slices share the Rust span/comment coordinate system; reproduced bare-CR regression now retains the guarded trace.
- Removed the source/path allowlist: all changed regular text blobs are considered, unknown formats use full-file raw tokens. Docs/config/hooks and nested src/build/dist/target/.cache/venv regressions cover both sides.
- Extracted production named-union-trace exclusion-spec assembly; a trace-only Guided spec causes Excluded in the decision regression. Named IDs alone still feed candidate/author/completion authority.
- Reader, writer and private_file_check share opened-file fstat validation (regular, exact0600,current euid). Nonblocking/no-follow writer; read errors propagate before append. Malformed/mode/FIFO regressions pass. Case-insensitive marker and stale-base docs nits included.

Plain current-main30e4171bed merge included as3a7eceee65 before rework. Conservative full-file fallback retained. Prior benchmark25/50 versus24/50 and46 fallback cases is explicitly historical for9386e30ebd, not a measurement of revised all-text collection; no new rate claimed.

Validation on final source: make check-ci-fast30/30 passed; forced workspace test compilation passed1146.6s (compile-only); actual fresh workspace test executable9e385c81053cb0c4 ran all76 mandate tests successfully, including all five new regressions. Formatting/diff/worktree clean. Initial narrow filter ran5 tests; initial broad targeted executable also passed76. A redundant queued Cargo runtime began recompiling narrower features, was cancelled (owned process group3699088 gone), then replaced by the final workspace executable run. No full-workspace runtime or green CI claim.
